title: The Honorable Thief
logline: An aging smuggler hires a pilot to manipulate an audit and bribe a vault clerk to recover a family heirloom they wrongly fenced.

roles.description: Tired, full of regrets, trying to make one last thing right.
Ambitious, treats the old thief with condescending pity.
A highly secure, automated depository for stolen goods.
A strict organization with absolute rules about fenced property.

public_situation: The {role:thieves_guild} is preparing for its annual audit of the {role:syndicate_vault}.
private_truth: The aging thief accidentally fenced an heirloom belonging to a poor family who saved their life, and the protege refuses to sell it back.

beats.public_change: The vault enters pre-audit lockdown, limiting all authorized access.

missions.reason: The thief hires the pilot to deliver a shipment of forged audit logs to the vault.
missions.private_fact: The logs are designed to trick the system into releasing the heirloom as legally sold property.

beats.public_change: The protege notices the missing item and triggers a full station alert.

missions.reason: The aging thief needs leverage and asks the pilot to scan the vault's manifest server for discrepancies to use as a distraction.
missions.private_fact: The scan reveals the protege is using the lockdown to quietly embezzle other goods.

beats.public_change: The guild leadership arrives to oversee the audit.

missions.reason: The thief asks the pilot to deliver the proof of the protege's embezzlement directly to the guild auditors.
missions.private_fact: The protege intercepts the pilot's comms, offering them a fortune to destroy the evidence instead.

resolutions.reached_by: The pilot delivers the evidence to the guild.
resolutions.summary: The guild violently deposes the protege. The aging thief returns the heirloom to its rightful owners and retires in peace.

consequences.public_summary: A pilot helped an old crook do one last good deed before they hung up their blaster.

resolutions.summary: The protege's embezzlement goes unnoticed. They consolidate power and execute the aging thief for breaking guild laws.

resolutions.reached_by: The pilot ignores the missions completely.
resolutions.summary: The theft fails. The heirloom remains locked away forever, and the old thief dies of a broken heart.

loose_threads.detail: The protege's embezzlement wasn't just greed; the funds were being routed to a planetary governor's re-election campaign.
The vault's quartermaster mentions the backdoor was actually installed decades ago by the aging thief themselves.

radio_hooks: {role:thieves_guild} promises full transparency in upcoming vault audit.
Rumors of internal guild strife dismissed by {role:ruthless_protege}.

voice_direction.aging_thief: Slow, raspy, speaks with deep exhaustion.
voice_direction.ruthless_protege: Sharp, energetic, treats everyone else like they are moving in slow motion.
